agent.profiles_warning.other: Some expert libraries are unavailable; showing the remaining profiles: %s

agent.description_help.other: brief description of the expert purpose

profile.selection_guidance.other: Choose an expert by description and skills. runtime_required applies to direct session launches; Tasks and schedules can use the distribution launch defaults. Explicit runtime and model choices take precedence. Use profile_get for full content details.

mcp.session.runtime.other: Execution runtime adapter; required for external v2 profiles, optional for builtin shortcuts with amux caller defaults

mcp.session.model.other: Execution model ref; omitted uses the selected runtime default

mcp.session.args.other: Native execution arguments, including permission settings

mcp.task.runtime.other: Execution runtime adapter; omitted uses the builtin shortcut preset or the distribution default for other experts

mcp.task.model.other: Execution model ref; omitted uses the parent session's current model and reasoning effort when it runs on the session's engine, otherwise the inherited launch preset model or the selected engine default

mcp.task.reasoning_effort.other: Reasoning effort ref; a session-spawned subtask inherits the session's current effort when it runs on the session's engine, otherwise the selected model's declared default

mcp.instance.model.other: Execution model ref frozen on the persistent instance; omitted uses the parent session's current model and reasoning effort when it runs on the session's engine, otherwise the inherited launch preset model or the selected engine default

mcp.instance.reasoning_effort.other: Reasoning effort ref frozen on the persistent instance; a session-spawned instance inherits the session's current effort when it runs on the session's engine, otherwise the selected model's declared default

mcp.task.extra_args.other: Native execution arguments; permission flags are normalized by permission_policy, other arguments retain their order

agent.render.runtime.other: Runtime adapter for rendering; required for external v2 profiles, optional for builtin shortcuts with amux caller defaults

agent.render.model.other: Model to render for the selected runtime

mcp.task.permission_policy.other: Task and native permission policy: policy-allow (default), escalate-to-main, or deny-all; overrides native permission flags; persistent instances retain this policy

mcp.schedule.model.other: Per-run model override for the scheduled execution; pass the current session model by default, otherwise the Profile or Agent default model

mcp.schedule.reasoning_effort.other: Per-run reasoning effort override for the scheduled execution; pass the current session effort by default, otherwise the selected model's declared default

mcp.schedule.permission_policy.other: Task and native permission policy: default or policy-allow (default), or deny-all; scheduled Tasks cannot use escalate-to-main; overrides native permission flags

update.helper.legacy_helper.other: The running isolation helper predates safe upgrade guards. During a maintenance window, pause new submissions, wait for sessions to finish, stop the helper, run amux update, then start it again. Subsequent updates are automatic.

update.helper.failed.other: Isolation helper update failed; the amux binaries may already be updated. Resolve the reported cause and retry amux update.

update.helper.privilege_failed.other: Could not run the isolation helper update with administrator privileges. Noninteractive sudo is required; ask an administrator to grant it or update the helper, then retry amux update.

update.helper.busy.other: Isolation helper update blocked by %d active launch(es). Existing sessions continue; retry amux update after they finish.

update.helper.unchanged.other: Isolation helper and materializer are already up to date.

update.helper.updated.other: Updated the isolation helper and materializer; existing isolation settings were preserved.

update.helper.bundle_missing.other: This update bundle did not install an isolation helper binary. Retry using a complete matching release bundle.

update.helper.invalid_unit.other: The installed helper unit is not in the supported managed format; ask an administrator to update it.

update.helper.invalid_source.other: Use an absolute path to a complete release bundle.

update.helper.custom_unit.other: A custom service unit or systemd drop-in is present; an administrator must update the helper while preserving that configuration.

update.helper.service_transition.other: The helper service is starting or stopping; retry after it settles.

update.helper.invalid_target.other: The installed helper directory must be a root-owned directory without symlinks or group/other write access.

update.helper.upgrade_locked.other: Another helper update is running; retry after it finishes.

update.maintenance.draining.other: Waiting for accepted work to finish before updating…

update.maintenance.ready.other: Upgrade maintenance ready; %d sessions will be restored afterward.

update.maintenance.failed.other: Could not prepare upgrade maintenance; update aborted.

update.maintenance.legacy.other: This Runtime predates coordinated upgrades. The helper safety guard still applies; active isolated launches require a one-time maintenance upgrade.

update.maintenance.timeout.other: Upgrade wait timed out after %s (%d busy sessions, %d active tasks). No active turn was cancelled.

update.maintenance.recovery_failed.other: Session recovery is incomplete. The Runtime retains the recovery list and retries automatically; check runtime logs.

update.maintenance.drain_timeout_help.other: Maximum wait for accepted work to finish before a Linux helper update

update.maintenance.expired.other: The upgrade maintenance lease expired. Retry the update.

cleanup.apply.other: Apply cleanup and notify configured administrators

cleanup.target.other: Runtime ID or name; empty selects all connected runtimes

cleanup.preview.other: Cleanup preview; data was not changed.

cleanup.applied.other: Cleanup finished; administrator reports are queued for delivery.

cleanup.step.other: %s: candidates=%d cleaned=%d skipped=%d bytes=%.2f MiB errors=%d

cleanup.partial.other: Some cleanup steps failed; inspect the report.

cleanup.invalid_time.other: Daily cleanup time must be HH:MM (00:00–23:59).

cleanup.invalid_paths.other: Protected workspace paths must be absolute paths, separated by spaces.
